findings.title: Keep linked dependency cache files readonly through their owned fixture aliases
findings.problem: The new exact creation exception allows external dependency directories to be linked beneath TMP. The mutation guard still decides ownership using only path.resolve and the spelled TMP prefix. A write or writable open through one of those owned symlink paths is forwarded to the native operation and follows the link into the external cache. The comment/contract says the target is readonly, but its aliases are not excluded from later mutations.

parentGuard inside returns true for this TMP-spelled path; writeFileSync is not a two-path operation, and the registered cacheLink branch is false for it. Its original native function is therefore forwarded instead of NATIVE_DENIAL.
